conclusion: Cults 公开源码（来源未固定，/workspace/tome4-dlcs/cults）tome-cults/data/talents/demented/chronophage.lua 断绝（Severed Threads）：实际处决在衰亡（Atrophy）施加处 :85-92，除生命低于阈值外还要 target:checkHit(法术强度, 物理豁免) 命中且 target:canBe("instakill") 才会 target:die(self) 并获得 INVIGORATE；即并非必定斩杀。现译“你将尝试切断目标的生命线，立刻杀死目标”的“尝试”与实现一致，info 原文省略了豁免判定。contextual 只据冻结 info 判断“无豁免依据”，宿主以实现为准驳回。

Cults 公开源码（来源未固定）tome-cults/data/talents/demented/doom.lua 天启（Revelation）选背叛预言时的 callbackOnTakeDamage（:231-259）：用 core.fov.circle_grids(self.x, self.y, 10, true) 只在自身 10 格半径内收集带 PROPHECY_OF_TREASON 的敌对目标再随机挑一个转移伤害；现译“转移至周围随机受背叛预言影响的目标”的“周围”与实现的范围限制一致。contextual 附带指出 whispers from the void 译“回响”略失“低语”，属不影响机制的措辞细节。驳回。

Cults 公开源码（来源未固定）tome-cults/overload/data/texts/unlock-race_krog.lua 克罗格解锁文本：原文“But while they are magic users Ziguranth took pity on them for they had not chosen their fate, it was forced upon them.”的让步“尽管他们是魔法使用者”是本句要点（伊格兰斯敌视魔法却仍同情食人魔），现译“然而，伊格兰斯同情他们被强迫而无法选择的命运。”整段删去，属漏译（contextual 同判）。另下一行“Zigur was finally able to create”现译主语换成“伊格兰斯”，与同条“伊格的坚实保护者”不一，按整句对照一并改回“伊格”。确认。修复：该行改为“然而，尽管食人魔是魔法使用者，伊格兰斯仍同情他们，因为这命运并非他们自己选择，而是被强加于身。”；下一行“伊格兰斯终于创造出”改为“伊格终于创造出”，其余（含 LF 与标记）不变。

return _t"New Race: #LIGHT_GREEN#Krog",
_t[[
Ogres were created long ago by terrible ways as elite fighters in the allure wars. Imbued from birth with runes their bodies can not survive without the arcane forces powering them.

But while they are magic users Ziguranth took pity on them for they had not chosen their fate, it was forced upon them.
After lots of painful, but required, experiments Zigur was finally able to create an offshoot of the ogre race by replacing their runes and arcane forces with drake blood and nature.
Ever since the Krogs as they are called have been mighty stalwards of nature and staunch protectors of Zigur. Elite fighters capable of dual wielding any one handed weapons to crush all foes of Nature!

You have rescued a group of them from the undead flith can now create new #LIGHT_GREEN#Krog#WHITE# characters!

Race features:#YELLOW#
- Their wrath is so terrible they can stun their foes with any attacks
- Drake infused blood that lets them resist the elements themselves
- A mastery of infusions like no others
- A warborn race, able to dual wield any one handed weapons and survive situations that would kill most others
#WHITE#
]]
